binding_status: RESEARCH_RULES_RETAINED; not an executable frozen batch

arms.Static-Pi: retain original assignment for pending nodes
arms.Dynamic-Pi: feedback-conditioned comparison of all pending assignments including retention

sampling.reason: No effect-size/variance or confirmatory sample calculation from matched data; avoid inventing power.

feedback: first eligible natural feedback using preregistered rule; no forced anomalies; no-feedback is retained; actual snapshot absent
Q: independently adjudicated full terminal facts, E and K separately; unknown not imputed
C: native CNY/USD, failed calls, calibration, detection, planning, prefix and continuation separately; unsettled UNKNOWN
L: actual end-to-end wall clock including planning; common-prefix attribution equal; time waiting for other arm reported separately
primary_proposed: deadline-compliant terminal success against accepted full reference
statistical_plan: paired event-level success differences and Q/C/L; repetitions summarized within event, not independent n. At n=1 descriptive only, no population CI, p-value or equivalence claim. Confirmatory test/sample size not frozen without admitted tasks.
system_incomplete: keep NOT_STARTED separately, do not reclassify as model error; report censored/unknown costs and latencies
sensitivity: unresolved output judgments can have bounds, not substitute for independent reference approval
stops: global/per-model/per-arm atomic request and currency reservation
budget/actual deadline or slot constraint violation -> refuse
transport/system/evaluator/unknown usage errors -> stop dispatch, retain in-flight reservations
normal model failures recorded, dependency blocked; do not erase denominator
no transport retries, supplements, changed algorithms or new configurations to seek gains
